forum.guidelinesText: This is a space for support and harm reduction. Be respectful. Don't share info that identifies you. This is not medical advice.

safety.rulesIntro: This is a space for support and harm reduction. By taking part, you agree to:
safety.rule1: Respect. No attacks, judgement or hate.
safety.rule2: Don't identify yourself (or others). No real names, addresses or contacts.
safety.rule3: No buying, selling or offering substances.
safety.rule5: Shared info is personal experience — always double-check reliable sources.
safety.helpNote: If you're in immediate danger, call 112.

settings.title: Your account
settings.privacyText: In the forum you always appear as your alias, never your email or real name. Nobody can link the messages back to you.
